records.key: This model was trained with the old spaCR custom classifier, which clipped negative class scores to 0 and always used 3 image channels. That classifier was fixed in spaCR 1.5.1.8 and old models cannot be reused. Retrain the model with this version of spaCR.
records.source: This model was trained with the old spaCR custom classifier, which clipped negative class scores to 0 and always used 3 image channels. That classifier was fixed in spaCR 1.5.1.8 and old models cannot be reused. Retrain the model with this version of spaCR.
records.translation: 此模型是用旧版 spaCR 自定义分类器训练的，该分类器会将负的类别评分截断为 0，并且始终使用 3 个图像通道。该分类器已在 spaCR 1.5.1.8 中修复，旧模型无法再使用。请使用此版本的 spaCR 重新训练模型。

records.key: This custom classifier checkpoint records {recorded} image channels, but its saved weights take {saved}. The file is inconsistent. Retrain the model with this version of spaCR.
records.source: This custom classifier checkpoint records {recorded} image channels, but its saved weights take {saved}. The file is inconsistent. Retrain the model with this version of spaCR.
records.translation: 此自定义分类器检查点记录了 {recorded} 个图像通道，但其保存的权重接受 {saved} 个。该文件不一致。请使用此版本的 spaCR 重新训练模型。

records.key: This classifier was trained on {expected}-channel images, but the images given have {given} channels. Use the same channels as in training, or retrain the model on these channels with this version of spaCR.
records.source: This classifier was trained on {expected}-channel images, but the images given have {given} channels. Use the same channels as in training, or retrain the model on these channels with this version of spaCR.
records.translation: 此分类器是用 {expected} 通道图像训练的，但给出的图像有 {given} 个通道。请使用与训练时相同的通道，或使用此版本的 spaCR 在这些通道上重新训练模型。
